system.description:
You bellow a resonant roar that shakes your allies of their hesitation and emboldens their aggression. All creatures of your choice are Emboldened for the duration.

An Emboldened creature gains the following;

+1d6 bonus to their damage rolls

Once per turn, on a successful attack, they may move 10 feet as part of the attack, not triggering attack of opportunities.

Resistance to the Demoralized, Dazed and Shaken conditions.

Dragon Rage State. If this jutsu is cast while in your Dragon Rage State, this jutsu’s casting time becomes a Bonus Action.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, this jutsu gains the Efficient keyword.
